newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF names six fund managers for 2 bln Ff.
newsitem.headline: AGF names six fund managers for 2 bln Ff.

text.p: French insurer Centrale des Assurances Generales de France (AGF) said on Wednesday that it has appointed six fund managers to handle a total two billion francs, as announced at the time of its privatisation last year.
- Schroder Investment Management and Templeton for shares in emerging markets
- Credit Swiss Asset Management and Fischer Francis Trees & Watts for international bonds
- Massachussets Financial Services Institutional Advisors for U.S. small capitalisations
- Schroder Investment Management for European small capitalisations
- Henderson Investors for Japanese small capitalisations.
A second selection will be made to handle 2.5 billion francs in international high yield bonds and hedge funds.
Cambridge Associates of Britain is in charge of the selection process, it said.
